name: Integrated Photonic Devices and Circuits
description: Introduction to photonic integrated circuits and devices, optical waveguides: optical waveguide theory, orthogonality condition of guided modes, single-mode and multimode waveguides, slab waveguides, channel waveguides (buried channel waveguides, strip-loaded waveguides, ridge waveguides, rib waveguides), slot waveguides, photonic crystal waveguides, waveguide bends, coupled mode theory (CMT), application of CMT to directional couplers, Mach-Zehnder interferometers and grating waveguides, super-mode analysis (SMA), application of SMA to tapered waveguides and Y-junction splitter/combiners, coupling of light into and out of photonic integrated circuits, integrated photonic platforms on various materials and their fabrication methodologies, photonic integrated passive devices: directional couplers, Mach-Zehnder interferometer, microring resonator, arrayed-waveguide gratings, integrated Fabry-Perot resonators, Bragg grating waveguides, mulitplexers and demultiplexers, photonic integrated active devices: integrated light sources, integrated photodetectors, reconfigurable filters, integrated thermo-optic switches, integrated electro-optic switches, Tunable delay lines, integrated modulators, integration of photonic devices and circuits: field programmable photonic gate array, photonic logic circuits, integrated transmitters and receivers, silicon photonic integrated devices and circuits, III-V photonic integrated devices and circuits.
